questions.text: What was the total invoiced amount in the first quarter of 2026?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT SUM(amount_aed) AS total FROM invoices WHERE invoice_date >= '2026-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2026-04-01'

questions.text: Which vendor has the highest total invoiced amount?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT v.name, SUM(i.amount_aed) AS total FROM invoices i JOIN vendors v ON v.vendor_id = i.vendor_id GROUP BY v.vendor_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM invoices WHERE status = 'overdue'

questions.text: What is the total amount of unpaid invoices, open and overdue together?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT SUM(amount_aed) AS total FROM invoices WHERE status IN ('open', 'overdue')

questions.text: Total invoiced amount by cost centre, highest first.
questions.referenceSql: SELECT c.name, SUM(i.amount_aed) AS total FROM invoices i JOIN cost_centres c ON c.cost_centre_id = i.cost_centre_id GROUP BY c.cost_centre_id ORDER BY total DESC

questions.text: What is the average invoice amount on the Software account?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT AVG(i.amount_aed) AS average FROM invoices i JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = i.account_id WHERE a.name = 'Software'

questions.text: How many vendors have no invoices at all?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM vendors WHERE vendor_id NOT IN (SELECT vendor_id FROM invoices)

questions.text: Who sent the single largest invoice, and for how much?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT v.name, i.amount_aed FROM invoices i JOIN vendors v ON v.vendor_id = i.vendor_id ORDER BY i.amount_aed DESC LIMIT 1

questions.text: Total Travel spend for each month of 2026.
questions.referenceSql: SELECT substr(i.invoice_date, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(i.amount_aed) AS total FROM invoices i JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = i.account_id WHERE a.name = 'Travel' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

questions.text: How many paid invoices does the IT cost centre have?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM invoices i JOIN cost_centres c ON c.cost_centre_id = i.cost_centre_id WHERE c.name = 'IT' AND i.status = 'paid'

questions.text: Which cost centre has the largest overdue amount?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT c.name, SUM(i.amount_aed) AS overdue FROM invoices i JOIN cost_centres c ON c.cost_centre_id = i.cost_centre_id WHERE i.status = 'overdue' GROUP BY c.cost_centre_id ORDER BY overdue DESC LIMIT 1

questions.text: How much did we spend with vendors in the Software category?
questions.referenceSql: SELECT SUM(i.amount_aed) AS total FROM invoices i JOIN vendors v ON v.vendor_id = i.vendor_id WHERE v.category = 'Software'
